tools.name: list_app_bootstrap_skill_files
tools.title: List App Bootstrap Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'app-bootstrap' skill, the platform's guidance for standing up a platform app from scratch and getting its @semoss/sdk plumbing right, in any flavor - plain HTML with no build step, vanilla TypeScript, or React. Call this when the user is scaffolding a new app, asks how to use the SDK without React, or when the app's bootstrap is broken - a blank screen on load, a 'module is required' error, a 'No response' pixel failure, a login screen that never clears, pixels that work in isolation but fail against the project, or uploads that come back in the wrong shape. Also call it when the user names Insight, initialize, InsightProvider, useInsight, usePixel, runPixel, Env, the semoss-env tag, SetContext, waitForEmbedAuth, InsightWebSocket, or the client-to-portals layout. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for what a specific pixel returns - see the database, model, vector, room, agent-run, and file-uploads skills - and not for compiling or publishing (see build-and-publish).

project.title: project
project.description: The app-bootstrap skill (app-bootstrap). Always this value.

tools.name: read_app_bootstrap_skill_file
tools.title: Read App Bootstrap Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'app-bootstrap' skill in full, for wiring up an app's insight lifecycle and pixel plumbing. Pass filePath exactly as list_app_bootstrap_skill_files reports it. SKILL.md is the main guide and is framework-agnostic: how the base insight is created and bound to the project with SetContext, gating on isInitialized/isAuthorized/isReady, the runPixel envelope and error handling, Env and semoss-env for dev versus published builds, auth, uploads, streaming, websockets, embed auth, and a troubleshooting table. references/vanilla-app.md is a complete app with no framework (no-build HTML importing the SDK from the CDN, plus a bundled TypeScript setup). references/react-app.md is the React scaffold. references/api-surface.md lists every export and flags which ones need React.

project.title: project
project.description: The app-bootstrap skill (app-bootstrap). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_app_bootstrap_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide, 'references/vanilla-app.md' for a no-framework app, 'references/react-app.md' for the React scaffold, or 'references/api-surface.md' for the export list.
